name: create_complaint
description: Creates a new civic complaint in Fic City after gathering category, description, and location from citizen.

category_id.description: Category ID e.g. cat-1 (Garbage), cat-2 (Pothole), cat-3 (Streetlight), cat-4 (Drainage)

description.description: Full description of the civic problem

address.description: Street address, area, or landmark in Delhi

is_anonymous.description: Whether to hide citizen phone number from public view

name: get_complaint_status
description: Retrieves live status, assigned officer, resolution photo proof, and SLA deadline for a complaint.

complaint_id.description: Ticket ID e.g. FC-2026-000101 or UUID

name: search_nearby_complaints
description: Finds existing active complaints in the citizen's neighborhood to avoid filing duplicate tickets and offer 'Me Too' upvote.

name: escalate_complaint
description: Escalates an overdue or delayed complaint to the Zonal Municipal Commissioner.

name: get_ward_info
description: Looks up Municipal Ward number, Councillor name, contact phone, and zonal office.

ward_number_or_name.description: Ward number (e.g. 64) or locality name (e.g. Karol Bagh)

name: search_faq
description: RAG search across municipal bylaws, SLAs, helpline numbers, and grievance policies.
